_about: THIS REGISTRY IS EMPTY, AND THAT IS ITS CURRENT CORRECT STATE.
A residue appears here only after the full pipeline has been run for it and
the resulting parameters have been validated. No parameterization has been
performed by this project, so nothing is listed. The consequence is that every
proposal involving non-canonical chemistry is emitted as a research request
rather than as a recommendation -- which is the specified behaviour, not a gap
Adding an entry is a claim that the work was done. Do not add one to make a

_entry_schema.residue_code: as it appears in the catalogue
_entry_schema.stages_completed: ordered subset of the pipeline stages, all required
_entry_schema.geometry_method: level of theory for the optimisation
_entry_schema.esp_method: level of theory and grid for the electrostatic potential
_entry_schema.torsion_scans: which dihedrals were scanned, at what spacing
_entry_schema.experimental_validation: conformational data compared against, with citation
_entry_schema.validated_against: what the parameters reproduce, and what they do not

Aib.force_field: GAFF2-compatible (charges only; no bonded terms fitted yet)
Aib.geometry_started_from: GFN2-xTB optimised geometry (ASE BFGS, fmax 0.02 eV/A)
Aib.esp_method: HF/6-31G* on a Connolly, shells at 1.4, 1.6, 1.8, 2.0 x vdW radius
known_deficiencies: Single-conformer fit. Chemically equivalent groups are not constrained to equal charges across substituents, only within each methyl, so constitutionally identical substituents can differ. Carbon charges span 0.718 e. A multi-conformer fit with explicit inter-group equivalencing is the standard remedy and has not been run.
Aib.validated_against: Nothing. The charges reproduce an HF/6-31G* electrostatic potential, which is what they were fitted to. No comparison against experimental conformational data has been made, and until one is these parameters describe a calculation rather than a molecule.
Aib.files: artifact recorded inline; no force-field files produced yet
